🔬 New method reveals damage in individual cells

Cologne Researchers have developed a method that, for the first time, enables damage to individual cells to be precisely quantified. The method uses molecular markers – specifically gene expression – and thus enables the detailed analysis of disease progression in individual tissue samples, such as a biopsy.
